subject.title: fix #93908: [Bug]: [Bug]: Feishu plugin skipping discovery - host reports 2026.5.28 despite 2026.6.8 install

question: Should this PR land as the scoped post-core update handoff fix using the installed target package version for plugin compatibility checks, and how should maintainers handle the linked issue's newer runtime unknown-host reproduction?
rationale: The code change is narrow and plausible, but it changes upgrade-sensitive plugin compatibility behavior and the linked issue has newer evidence outside the PR's stated scope.

options.title: Land scoped fix and track runtime variant
options.body: Accept installed-target compatibility for post-core updates, but keep or create a visible follow-up for the runtime unknown-host path before letting the linked issue disappear.

options.title: Require broader fix before merge
options.body: Hold this PR until it also addresses runtime host-version resolution for global npm/systemd startup failures.

options.title: Land and close linked issue
options.body: Treat the later unknown-host report as distinct enough that this PR may close the stale update-handoff report as-is.

recommendation.title: Land scoped fix and track runtime variant
recommendation.body: Accept installed-target compatibility for post-core updates, but keep or create a visible follow-up for the runtime unknown-host path before letting the linked issue disappear.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent update lifecycle history makes steipete the best available owner for the compatibility/upgrade-source decision.
